description: This file is a shell script that provides a set of command-line functions for managing git submodules, including adding, initializing, updating, deinitializing, and listing submodules. It contains functions that wrap git commands and parse command-line options to perform various submodule operations.

methods.name: cmd_add
methods.description: Handles adding new submodules with various options.

methods.name: cmd_foreach
methods.description: Executes a command in each checked out submodule.

methods.name: cmd_update
methods.description: Updates submodule paths to correct revisions, performing clone or checkout as needed.

methods.name: cmd_set_branch
methods.description: Sets the default branch for a submodule.

methods.name: cmd_set_url
methods.description: Sets or updates the remote URL of a submodule.

methods.name: cmd_summary
methods.description: Shows a commit summary for submodules in the index or working tree.

methods.name: cmd_status
methods.description: Lists all submodules with their status.

methods.name: cmd_sync
methods.description: Synchronizes remote URLs for submodules with their configuration.
